overall_assessment: UiT extraction via #maincontents is generally faithful: whole plans for the right course and year, no site chrome, and the uncaptured text is only year pickers, apply-period banners and staff boxes. The four suspects are false alarms (thin source page, year-picker lines) apart from minor junk on old pages. The one real gap is the reading list on new-layout pages (Leganto), where only the heading is kept.

findings.description: On new-layout pages (2019-2025) the reading list is only a Leganto notice plus a 'Pensumliste for <code> <title>' heading; the actual list is absent from extracted_text. The reading_list section for these course-years is therefore empty or a bare heading. The packet's uncaptured text does not show it either, so the list is probably loaded by JavaScript from Leganto and not in the fetched HTML.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Reading list is rendered client-side from Leganto (external service); the harvested HTML only contains the placeholder link.
findings.suggested_fix: Confirm in the raw html whether a Leganto list id or URL is present and, if so, fetch the list via site_request(); otherwise record in data notes that UiT reading lists on pages from about 2019 are not available and drop the empty 'Pensumliste for' heading from the text.

findings.evidence: Du kan se og få tilgang til deler av pensum via Leganto.
findings.description: The boilerplate sentence about Leganto access is kept in the text on every new-layout page. It is site boilerplate, not plan content.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Not removed by exclude or post_fn for uit in R/institution_config.R.
findings.suggested_fix: Add the sentence 'Du kan se og få tilgang til deler av pensum via Leganto.' to the uit exclude/post_fn (boilerplate per course_plan_spec.md).

findings.evidence: JUR-2502 3. avdeling master. Hjemmeeksamen med muntlig prøve, JUR-2503 3. avdeling master. Skoleeksameneller JUR-2502 3. avdeling master. Hjemmeeksamen med muntlig prøve
findings.description: The prerequisite list repeats the same alternatives four times and glues 'Skoleeksamen' and 'eller' together.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The page's prerequisite widget lists nested elements for each alternative group; text of nested elements is concatenated without separators.
findings.suggested_fix: Check the raw html for the nested structure; emit separators between nested inline elements in R/blocks.R or deduplicate repeated list items for the prerequisites block.

findings.description: Old-layout (2008) pages end with a timetable fragment (first lecture date/room, lecturer table) with glued labels ('ForeleserF.aman.'). This is logistics and staff names, not plan content, and is garbled. The pre-pass 'junk' flag on HIF-3022 is real but minor.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The old template has a lecture schedule table inside #maincontents; table cells are concatenated without separators.
findings.suggested_fix: In the uit post_fn drop lines starting with 'Lectures ' / 'Undervisning ' followed by a semester and the following 'Forelesning' table row; or exclude the schedule element by selector.

findings.evidence: ¿ Utvikling av utøvende ferdigheter på hovedinstrument
findings.description: Characters from the source (bullet, dash, apostrophe) appear as the replacement character '¿' on 2019 pages, and the bullets run into one paragraph. Information is mildly degraded, e.g. '6 ¿ 12 days'.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Encoding damage in the source system's data (Windows-1252 characters lost upstream), not in the pipeline.
findings.suggested_fix: Accept as a source limitation, or map '¿' at line start to a bullet and between digits to an en dash in the uit post_fn.
